oneLiner: Throw shuriken into a spinning scroll post — never nick your own blades — and cleave the post when its ink rings fill.

verbs.name: throw
verbs.cost: Commits one blade to a gap that keeps rotating — mistime it and it shatters

verbs.name: wait
verbs.cost: Gives up score tempo — the post keeps spinning and the safe window drifts

verbs.name: zantie
verbs.cost: Spends a limited Iron Cut charge to reveal a safe angle for one throw

decisions.choice: Throw at the first wide gap or wait for the rotation to settle
decisions.cost: First gap may be a trap / slower tempo

decisions.choice: Chase the symmetric bonus on the twin posts or play it safe
Spend Iron Cut now on a fast post or save it for the final blade
Throw early during a reversal window or wait for it to finish
Aim for the narrow leftover gap or bank the safe wide gap
On the moving post: lead the drift or wait for it to slow at the turn
Go for the double symmetric pair under pulse boost or single safe stick
Burn the final Iron Cut for a guaranteed cleave or trust your timing

levels.newElement: round post — teach the throw/stick core loop
speed pulse — the post briefly accelerates
square post + reversal — direction flips, Iron Cut unlocks
pulse + reversal combined on a square post
twin posts — throw alternates between two spinning scrolls
twin posts + reversal — mirror timing under flips
twin posts + pulse — symmetric bonus under boost
twin posts + pulse + reversal — full chaos
moving post — the scroll drifts side to side
moving post + reversal — drift flips direction
moving post + pulse + reversal — the final cleave

upgrades.desc: Iron Cut: reveal a safe angle for one throw (every 3 levels)
Twin-post symmetric landing within 15° grants bonus points
Square posts tighten the collision window, changing spacing rules
Moving posts make the impact point drift, changing aim timing
Speed pulses multiply rotation, forcing a new tempo read
More knives per level raise the difficulty ceiling
Level-clear bonus scales with level index

signatureMoment: The final shuriken lands, time slows, a ring of blade-light blooms around the post and the scroll splits in two in a spray of ink
antiScope: 不做竖屏专属模式（横竖 letterbox 兼容即可）
